description: This file implements a gRPC server handler for Kuksa, including methods for authorization, data retrieval, setting values, and managing subscriptions. It contains class definitions, helper functions, and server setup logic.

classes.name: RequestServiceImpl
classes.description: Implements the gRPC service interface for handling client requests, including authorization, get/set operations, and subscription management.

classes.name: grpcSession
classes.description: Represents a session with a peer, identified by peer address and UUID.

classes.name: GrpcSessionHasher
classes.description: Hash function for grpcSession objects used in unordered_map.

methods.name: grpc_send_object_to_stream
methods.description: Sends a data object to a gRPC stream with proper value filling.

methods.name: grpc_fill_value
methods.description: Fills a gRPC Value message based on datatype and JSON data.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads SSL certificate data from a file.

methods.name: authorizeHelper
methods.description: Performs authorization for a session and creates KuksaChannel.

methods.name: authChecker
methods.description: Retrieves KuksaChannel for a session based on server context.

methods.name: getKuksaChannelForSubscriptionContext
methods.description: Creates or retrieves KuksaChannel for subscription context.

methods.name: RunServer
methods.description: Sets up and runs the gRPC server with optional SSL configuration.
